∀ (dimension : ℕ),
  2 ≤ dimension →
    ∀ (exponent : ℝ),
      1 / 3 < exponent →
        ∃ first second firstMap secondMap,
          MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure first ∧
            MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure second ∧
              OAI.Problem358.IsSupported first (OAI.Problem358.cube dimension) ∧
                OAI.Problem358.IsSupported second (OAI.Problem358.cube dimension) ∧
                  OAI.Problem358.HasExactlyThreeAtoms first (OAI.Problem358.cube dimension) ∧
                    OAI.Problem358.HasExactlyThreeAtoms second (OAI.Problem358.cube dimension) ∧
                      first ≠ second ∧
                        OAI.Problem358.IsUniqueQuadraticOptimalMap
                            (OAI.Problem358.uniformMeasure (OAI.Problem358.cube dimension)) first firstMap ∧
                          OAI.Problem358.IsUniqueQuadraticOptimalMap
                              (OAI.Problem358.uniformMeasure (OAI.Problem358.cube dimension)) second secondMap ∧
                            0 < OAI.Problem358.wasserstein2 first second ∧
                              OAI.Problem355.heilbronnExponent *
                                  (OAI.Problem358.wasserstein2 first second).rpow exponent <
                                OAI.Problem358.mapL2Dist (OAI.Problem358.uniformMeasure (OAI.Problem358.cube dimension))
                                  firstMap secondMap
